description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceReviewSearchFilterParams class, which extends a filter parameters class to encapsulate filtering options for performance review searches within an HR management plugin. It includes constants for sortable fields and statuses, properties for various filter criteria (e.g., employee number, date range), and getter/setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering performance review searches, including filter criteria such as employee number, reviewer, job title, subunit, status, date range, and review activity status.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer employee number filter.

methods.name: setReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the reviewer employee number filter.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date filter for the review period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date filter for the review period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date filter for the review period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date filter for the review period.

methods.name: isExcludeInactiveReviews
methods.description: Checks whether inactive reviews are excluded from search.

methods.name: setExcludeInactiveReviews
methods.description: Sets the filter to exclude inactive reviews.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves the current setting for included employees.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the filter for which employees to include in search.
